arStrings.szText:
While in {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, Casting {c_important}Archfiend{/c} Skills additionally Summons the {c_important}Archfiend{/c} Demon:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Rampage{/c} summons a brute for {c_number}{SF_1}{/c} seconds that follows you and swipes at enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_RAMPAGE}{/c} damage.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} summons a demonic head that orbits you and spews flames, dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_INFERNAL_BREATH}{/c} damage per hit.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} summons {c_number}{SF_6}{/c} additional demon hands that each deal {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_TYRANTS_GRASP}{/c} damage.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Profane Sentinel{/c} summons an additional eye for {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} seconds that follows you and blasts enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_PROFANE_SENTINEL}{/c} damage.
